Two tests read repository-root state that another process can change mid-read. Both pass in CI only because a fresh runner starts clean. Trying to run the suite under `pytest-xdist` surfaced them.

## Site 1 — the one nobody would have guessed

```
FAILED test_two_runs_differ_only_in_the_timestamp
  unexpected non-determinism:
    ('| Working tree | dirty -- 7 path(s) differ from HEAD |',
     '| Working tree | dirty -- 9 path(s) differ from HEAD |')
```

The generator is not at fault. `generate_evidence.py:405` measures `git status --porcelain`, and the count moved **between** the two runs being compared — so they had different inputs and were right to differ.

**Root cause:** `pytest-cov` under xdist writes one `.coverage.<host>.<pid>.<random>` per worker into the rootdir. `.gitignore` had the exact name `.coverage`, which doesn't match those.

```
before:  git check-ignore -v .coverage.runner.123.456  ->  exit 1, NOT ignored
after:   git check-ignore -v .coverage.runner.123.456  ->  .gitignore:13
```

Fixed at the source rather than teaching the test to tolerate a moving input. Latent independently of xdist — any parallel coverage run leaves those fragments untracked.

## Site 2 — the one the plan named

`test_missing_report_is_not_run_never_pass` read the **live** repo-root `reports/` and asserted something was missing from it. Its ability to discriminate depended on what you'd run last.

The property is unchanged and **the assertion is not weakened**. The test now *creates* the condition instead of hoping to find it: an isolated tree from `git ls-files` (194 tracked files — exactly a fresh checkout) with a `reports/` it controls. Using the tracked-file list excludes every generated directory by construction and can't drift like a hand-maintained ignore list.

A regression guard comes with it: if isolation ever reverts to `cwd=REPO`, a real report in the repo root would make the assertion vacuous and nothing would say so.

## What this unblocks

```
serial    117.46s   exit 0
-n auto    56.13s   exit 0     2.09x
765 progress dots in both — identical execution count
```

That measurement belongs to the benchmark on #25 and is recorded here only as evidence that **these two defects, not xdist, were the blocker**. This PR adds no parallelism and changes no CI configuration.
